sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 175 clearly states the first procedural step in the worked Rand–Mitte case: order Rand reactions by kind of Triebgefahr, using frequency and strength of the danger types to guide the ordering.

The remainder of printed page 175 applies the procedure to a ten-profile case, grouping Quantumspannungen, Tendenzspannungen, Kontakttriebgefahren and then analyzing the Mitte. The case is retained as a worked example, not promoted wholesale into doctrine.

sourceExcerpt: Die erste Aufgabe besteht nun darin, die Randtriebreaktionen nach Art der Zr/ebgefzhr zu ordnen. Bei der Wahl der Ordnungsweise lenkt uns 1. die Häufigkeit, 2. die Stärke der Gefahrarten.
romanianRendering: În aplicarea clinică a metodei, Szondi formulează prima sarcină: reacțiile Rand-ului sunt ordonate după tipul de Triebgefahr, iar ordonarea este ghidată de două criterii explicite, frecvența și intensitatea formelor de pericol în seria de profiluri.
doctrinalStatement: Metoda Rand–Mitte nu citește o serie ca o colecție de reacții izolate. În analiza Randgefahren, sursa cere mai întâi clasificarea reacțiilor după tipul de Triebgefahr și apoi prioritizarea lor după Häufigkeit și Stärke în serie. Cazul 1 de pe pagina 175 arată aplicarea concretă pe zece profiluri, dar concluziile sale despre persoană nu sunt generalizate în acest record.
conditions: Applies to repeated-profile series analyzed with the source-defined Rand–Mitte method.
Frequency and strength order already-calculated source-defined reaction/danger structures; they do not create a new clinical diagnosis.
exceptions: Do not generalize the personal conclusions of Fall 1 to another protocol.
Do not replace configuration/context analysis with frequency counts alone.
Do not treat frequency or strength as a contemporary external risk score.
scopeNotes: Worked example: Fall 1, printed page 175, applies the rule to a ten-profile series and organizes Rand findings into Quantumspannungen, Tendenzspannungen and Kontakttriebgefahren before moving to Analyse der Mitte.
This worked case is deliberately retained as an example reference rather than decomposed into multiple case-specific doctrines.

relations.note: Applies the Rand half of the Rand–Mitte method to a profile series.
Orders observations using the source-defined Triebgefahr categories.
